total.description: Total work orders matching the filters (all pages).

total_pages.description: Number of pages for this query.

has_more.description: True if there are more pages after this one.

date_field.description: Date attribute used for the date range.

date_from.description: Start date applied (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive); null if no date filter.

date_to.description: End date applied (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive); null if no date filter.

filters.description: Normalized filters applied, by parameter name.

items.description: Work orders in this page, ordered by date_field descending. Only the requested fields are present; dates are yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss in server time.

error.description: Present only when the request is invalid. No other field is returned.
